original.target_description: Ackerman et al. Participants that evaluate a resume while using a heavier clipboard will rate (2010), Science the resume as better overall compared to the participants that evaluate the resume while using a lighter clipboard. The original study used F -test for a two condition comparison, p < 0.05. Original test statistics: Heavy Condition: N = 26, M = 5.80, SD = 0.76; Light Condition: N = 28, M = 5.38, SD = 0.79. F (1, 52) = 4.08, p = 0.049. If there were no covariates in the model, we will convert the F to t for comparison with the replication tests.
